title: German Keto Pasta Bake
description: A low-carb twist on the classic pasta bake, using german sausage and silky cream.

ingredients.name: Pasta
ingredients.amount: 8 oz (zucchini noodles or shirataki noodles work well for keto)

ingredients.name: Silky Cream
ingredients.notes: Heavy cream or coconut cream work well

instructions: Cook the German sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the bacon to the skillet and cook until crispy.
Add the pasta to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the silky cream, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the cream mixture over the pasta and sausage mixture, and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
